by: controller (claude), run directly -- Grok slots were held by a concurrent campaign and the user authorized doing it inline
one_line: GLM-5.2-H0.98-Math-Preserve, the sealed Odyssey substrate, cannot generate coherent text. The runtime and the serve path are both faithful; the artifact itself predicts nonsense.
the_question: Serving the sealed artifact returned byte-identical '99999999' for two unrelated prompts. Was that the artifact, or the path serving it?

how_it_was_settled.method: the campaign's own discriminator, unchanged from the Llama-1B case: a numpy oracle reading the SAME 282 .gravity shards through the SAME codec, compared against the Rust/Metal runtime on identical token ids. Neither consults source safetensors.
how_it_was_settled.note_on_scope: This was run against Math-Preserve ITSELF. It is not inherited from the sealed General-R0 parity receipt.

logit_comparison.why_this_probe_is_decisive: This is a MATH continuation failing on an artifact whose entire purpose is to preserve mathematics. It cannot be dismissed as a general-knowledge probe outside the profile.

execution_correctness.verdict: PASS -- the decoders agree on what the payload means
execution_correctness.evidence: argmax and top-5 match in exact order on both probes, oracle vs Rust/Metal, on Math-Preserve itself
execution_correctness.consequence: the runtime is exonerated. Whatever is wrong is in what the artifact encodes, not in how it is read.

serve_path_correctness.verdict: PASS -- the serve path is faithful, H2 is REFUTED
serve_path_correctness.evidence: The chat-templated prompt '[gMASK]<sop><|system|>Reasoning Effort: Max<|user|>The capital of France is<|assistant|><think>' produces top-5 [24]'9'=10.432, [21]'6'=9.408, [23]'8'=9.053. Token id 24 is '9'. That EXACTLY reproduces the served output '99999999'. The HTTP path returned precisely what the model gave it.
serve_path_correctness.also_refuted: the prompt does reach the model. Tokenization is correct -- 'The capital of France is' encodes to [785, 6722, 315, 9621, 374] decoding to ['The',' capital',' of',' France',' is'] -- and the argmax DIFFERS across prompts, so the model conditions on its input.

the_shape_of_the_failure.not_a_dead_vector: logits are finite across all 154,880 entries, well spread (16.9 to 21.2), and peaked. This is not a flat or NaN output.
the_shape_of_the_failure.not_prompt_independent_at_the_model: different prompts give different argmax: 43196, 47612, 20300, 24. The model reads its input.
the_shape_of_the_failure.what_is_gone: semantics. The distribution is confident and wrong. ' combust' for the capital of France, 'rus' for 2 + 2.
the_shape_of_the_failure.bisect_reading: The control tokens shift the prediction but do not cause the failure. Every form is wrong, including bare text with no control tokens at all. This is not a template or special-token-embedding defect.

consistent_with: Llama-3.2-1B at 0.8774 BPW emitted ' settle settle settle', proven to be the artifact by this same oracle method
GLM-5.2 General-R0 at 0.8829 BPW failed screening twice
General-R0 at 0.9211 BPW still failed after lm_head and embed_tokens native protection
relation_to_prior_campaign_findings.what_this_adds: The ceiling is higher than R0. Math-Preserve at 0.9774 BPW -- with 67,526,197,248 bytes of protected islands and 244,667,548 bytes of headroom under the H0.98 target -- ALSO fails. Sub-bit compression of this parent destroys generation at 0.977 BPW, not merely at 0.88.
relation_to_prior_campaign_findings.what_this_does_not_establish: the BPW at which capability survives, if any. Only that 0.9774 is not it.

consequences.ODYSSEY_LAUNCH_AUTHORIZED: must stay FALSE. Odyssey T0-T7 would train against a substrate that cannot complete '2 + 2 ='. Gate G1 (substrate sealed) is met and always was -- 282/282 shards, 59,585 frozen decisions, 0 mismatches, byte-perfect. None of that was ever evidence of capability. This is the exact failure ODYSSEY_PROMOTION_GATE.md was written to prevent, and it cannot be un-trained.
consequences.G4: NOT MET. The live turn loop reaches real generated tokens through a live entry point, which is genuine progress, but the tokens are not a functioning model.
consequences.G5: the support-halo pre-Odyssey baseline must NOT be run. Scoring 26 tasks here would produce a floor-level baseline that silently encodes the collapse, and every later regression measurement would be taken against it. It would also burn hours at 0.4 tok/s to learn nothing.
consequences.what_survives: everything built around it. The serve wire, the runtime, the codec, the oracle, HIDE, Fabric, Bridge, the evaluation harness and the contamination barrier are all correct and all still useful. The defect is in one artifact, and the machinery that found it is the machinery working.

what_i_did_not_check: whether a higher-BPW pack of the same parent recovers capability -- that is the obvious next experiment and it is a foundry question, not a runtime one
which tensors carry the damage. The bisect rules out control-token embeddings but does not localize it further.
whether the fault is in PASS3 packing or in the Math profile's allocation decisions
the BF16 parent's own output on these prompts -- deliberately, per campaign law: grade against what the artifact encodes via the oracle, never against the parent

what_this_unlocks_under_campaign_law.the_tension: Hawking's sub-bit-first LAW caps packing at one complete BPW. This artifact is at 0.9774 and cannot generate. So for this parent, the law's own ceiling and the capability floor are on the wrong sides of each other.

the_law_as_written.BpwEscalation: must stay sub-bit; leaving requires an Escape Receipt
the_law_as_written.EscapeAboveSubbit: denied without a sealed Escape Receipt
explicitly_rejected_evidence: f1_only -- 'F1 weight reconstruction is NOT capability proof; escape denied'
scheduler_deferred -- 'scheduler deferral is not scientific collapse; escape denied'
the_law_as_written.ordering_rule: 'representation-before-BPW: try a stronger family first' -- representation escalation precedes BPW escalation

what_this_unlocks_under_campaign_law.why_this_result_matters_to_that_gate: The law demands proof of scientific collapse and names the two cheap substitutes it will not accept. This finding is neither of them: it is a live generation failure on the real flagship artifact, at a known exact-rational BPW, confirmed by a numpy oracle reading the same container through the same codec, on two probes including one inside the artifact's own math profile. It is the category of evidence the Escape Receipt was written to require.
the_ordered_next_steps_the_law_implies: 1. Representation escalation FIRST: a stronger representation family at sub-bit. The law refuses BPW escalation before this is tried, and this finding does not exempt it.
2. Only if that saturates, seal an Escape Receipt and pack above 1 BPW.
3. Either way, re-run this exact attribution against the new pack before anything trains on it. The instrument and the oracle command are both recorded here.
what_this_unlocks_under_campaign_law.controller_note: This is a foundry decision and a governance decision, not a runtime one, and it belongs to the user. Recorded rather than acted on.
